metadata.description: Eight small, local Claude Code security mods: deterministic guardrails inside the process loop. Each mod is one folder under mods/.

plugins.name: code-scan-bridge
plugins.description: Local deterministic pattern bridge for new file content. Not the official Claude Security plugin and not a data-flow scanner.

plugins.name: design-guard
plugins.description: Appends architecture rules as Claude-only context on every prompt, and drops prompts that explicitly tell Claude to ignore or bypass security rules.

plugins.name: eval-gate
plugins.description: Default-closed eval gate. External Promptfoo runs in CI are the real gate; this mod is defence in depth only.

plugins.name: nhi-scoper
plugins.description: Short-lived credential gate. Fetches a token from a configured broker only; it never invents a token and never falls back to a long-lived credential.

plugins.name: secret-scrubber
plugins.description: Redacts secret patterns from prompts, shell commands and shell output, blocks writes that contain secrets, and denies reads and mentions of secret files.

plugins.name: token-tally
plugins.description: Per-session token tally. Records usage totals in the store and prints the turn total; it is not a token stream or a server-side audit chain.

plugins.name: tool-call-guard
plugins.description: Local deterministic guard for dangerous Bash and PowerShell commands. Not the Rulebricks product; no network calls.

plugins.name: trace-audit
plugins.description: Observable audit trace only. Records tool calls and turn completions to a capped store log; it never blocks work.
